text:
There is so much solitude in that gold.
+
+The moon of nights is not the moon
+
+the first Adam saw. The long centuries
+
+of human wakefulness have filled it
+
+with ancient weeping. Look at it. It is your mirror.

translation.title: The Moon
translation.editorial_note: The moon accumulates human vigilance and grief across time; the final imperatives remain plain so the cosmic image turns abruptly intimate.
